conviction_note: Q3 itself was pre-guided on 2026-08-06: CELSIUS brand about like Q2 (-12% y/y), gross margin high-40s. Consensus has been cut about 7.6% over three months, and bottom-up arithmetic lands near the $800-816M bar, so the reported quarter is close to a wash. The reaction turns on the forward read. Negatives the market has partly seen: CELSIUS scans worsened to -5 to -10% at Barclays on Sept 8 (from -2% in Q2), and diesel rose from $5.35 on Aug 3, the level the margin guide was explicitly conditioned on, to $5.97 by Sept 7. Positives: Alani Nu (+~50% scans, PepsiCo's Oct 8 remarks say the Celsius partnership gained value share), a 2027 innovation calendar promised for this call, insider buying and the buyback. Findings net -1.0. The scaled number, p_up 46 on abs_move 13, gives -1.04: a small down-lean because the stock ran +11.8% in five days into the print with no catalyst I could find, while upside is paid in the options (skew -2.15, put/call OI 0.42). That lean is held near 50 by 5.5 days to cover of short interest. abs_move is set above the 10.9% implied move because this name's median print reaction is 17.3% and its last two prints that carried forward commentary moved -18.5% and -24.8%.
bar: Q3 2026 revenue about $800-816M and adjusted EPS $0.35-0.36. Chartmill has $815.94M / $0.36 (https://www.chartmill.com/stock/quote/CELH/estimates) and FXEmpire $815.74M / $0.35 from 20 analysts (https://www.fxempire.com/stocks/celh/earnings). Benzinga has $802.6M / $0.35 (https://www.benzinga.com/quote/CELH/earnings-forecasts), and B. Riley's 2026-11-02 preview cites consensus at $800.6M (https://ca.investing.com/news/stock-market-news/briley-reiterates-buy-on-celsius-stock-ahead-of-q3-results-93CH-4921046). So two source pairs agree internally, about $15M apart; EPS agrees across sources. Revenue-dependent findings are capped small for that reason. There is no numeric company guidance, only a qualitative pre-guide: Q3 CELSIUS brand 'a lot like the second quarter', gross margin 'consistent with the second ... high 40s' at Aug 6 diesel and aluminum levels (https://s203.q4cdn.com/427437840/files/doc_financials/2026/q2/Celsius-Holdings-Second-Quarter-2026-Earnings-Conference-Call-Transcript.pdf). B. Riley models $817.6M revenue and $172.9M adjusted EBITDA (21.1% margin).
positioning_check: Short interest was 30.11M shares at the 2026-10-15 settlement, 5.5 days to cover on 5.51M average volume, about 11.9% of 253.04M shares outstanding (https://massive.com/quote/celh, read 2026-11-04). It was 30.96M at 4.5 days on 2026-09-30, so roughly flat. As a share of float it is higher, since PepsiCo and the Alani Nu founders hold blocks; float % is not sourced. That is moderately crowded but not the 18-23% float zone. Skew_25d is -2.15 vol points (upside paid, mild), put/call OI 0.42, event-implied move 10.91%. The tape is +11.76% over 5 days and +16.16% over 20 days into the print, yet still -47.8% from the 52-week high. The market leans mildly up into the print.

findings.finding: The reported quarter was pre-guided and the bar has come down. On 2026-08-06 the CFO said Q3 CELSIUS brand should 'look a lot like the second' (Q2: -11.7% y/y to about $387M) and gross margin should stay in the high 40s. Since then Chartmill shows the Q3 revenue estimate cut 7.57% in three months, and JPMorgan, UBS and TD Cowen cut targets. Bottom-up arithmetic (CELSIUS about -12% on Q3 2025's ~$393M, plus Alani Nu about +20% on $332.0M, plus Rockstar about $66M) gives roughly $810M, inside the $800-816M bar.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q2 2026 revenue missed $870-886M consensus by about 6% and the stock fell 18.46%. Q3 2025 beat revenue ($725.1M vs $715.7M) and EPS ($0.42 vs $0.27) and still fell 24.8% on the Q4 'noise' warning. This name has not paid for the reported quarter when the forward read is soft.
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced. The pre-guide is public and the bar has been cut to it, which is why this is sized near zero. If the market expected a further CELSIUS miss, the bar would sit below $795M and the skew would be put-bid; instead it is $800-816M and upside is paid.
findings.independence: Consensus revision: https://www.chartmill.com/stock/quote/CELH/estimates. Q3 2025 brand dollars: https://ir.celsiusholdingsinc.com/news/news-details/2025/Celsius-Holdings-Reports-Third-Quarter-2025-Financial-Results/default.aspx. Target cuts: https://stockanalysis.com/stocks/celh/. Shares the Q2 transcript with the diesel finding (different passages).

findings.finding: Alani Nu consumption ran ahead into Q3. Management said Alani scans were about +50% after the Witch's Brew launch (Barclays, 2026-09-08; Witch's Brew billed on Aug 6 as 'the largest limited-time offer in the brand's history'). PepsiCo's Q3 prepared remarks (2026-10-08, 12 weeks to Sept 5) say 'the partnership with Celsius Holdings gained value share and holds nearly 20 percent share of the category'. Q2 Alani reported net sales grew +21% against +56% scans. If the Q3 gross-to-net gap narrows now the Pepsi DSD transition is complete, Alani could print above the roughly +20% (about $400M) implied in the bar.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q2 2026: Alani +21% reported was not enough to offset CELSIUS -12%, and the stock fell 18.46%. Q1 2026 (+4.45%) and Q4 2025 (+6.94%) were Alani-led beats bought modestly. On this name Alani strength buys single digits; CELSIUS weakness costs double digits.
findings.why_not_priced: Partly priced. The +50% scan figure was public on Sept 8, and the stock fell 6.5% that day on the CELSIUS read, not on Alani. PepsiCo's share statement came after Celsius last spoke, and the consensus cut of 7.6% over three months suggests models did not lift Alani. If it were priced, estimates would have risen since August, not fallen. Capped small because the revenue bar is disputed by about $15M and 'nearly 20 percent' is flat against Q2's 20.1%.
findings.independence: Barclays scan figures via B. Riley's preview: https://ca.investing.com/news/stock-market-news/briley-reiterates-buy-on-celsius-stock-ahead-of-q3-results-93CH-4921046. Q2 Alani +56% scans and the Witch's Brew LTO: https://www.marketbeat.com/instant-alerts/celsius-q2-earnings-call-highlights-2026-08-06/. Net of the rest: CELSIUS (about 45% of sales) is guided down about 12%, so Alani has to carry the print.

findings.finding: CELSIUS brand consumption got worse after the Q2 call. At Barclays on 2026-09-08 management put CELSIUS scans at -5% to -10% (IRI), against -2% tracked retail sales in Q2 that the CFO had called 'the consumer'. That undercuts the Aug 6 claim that the brand 'exit[s] the year back into growth', which matters for Q4/2027 commentary on the call.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The forward read on CELSIUS drove the last two big moves: -24.8% on 2025-11-06 (Q4 noise warning) and -18.46% on 2026-08-06 (brand -12%, 'went too deep' on rationalization). The stock also fell 6.5% on 2026-09-09, the day after these scan figures.
findings.why_not_priced: Partly priced: the stock fell 6.5% on it in September. But the stock is now up 13% from the Sept 9 close of $27.64, so the rebound has run ahead of any evidence that scans have turned. If the market still held the September read, the stock would not have rallied 11.8% in five sessions into the print with upside skew.
findings.independence: The same Barclays figure is cited independently in B. Riley's 2026-11-02 preview: https://ca.investing.com/news/stock-market-news/briley-reiterates-buy-on-celsius-stock-ahead-of-q3-results-93CH-4921046. That is one event in two write-ups, so it counts once. Shrunk for 5.5 days to cover of short interest.

findings.finding: Diesel rose well above the level the margin guide was set at. The Aug 6 high-40s gross margin guide was explicitly 'at current diesel and aluminum levels', with improvement only 'if fuel or aluminum moderates'. EIA on-highway diesel was $5.348 the week of Aug 3, $5.652 on Aug 24 and $5.967 on Sept 7 (+11.6% from the guide date), with secondary reports of a record about $6.53 the week of Sept 21. B. Riley's preview notes fuel costs rose in August and September. That pressures Q3 gross margin below Q2's 48.1% and the Q4 margin commentary.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Gross margin compression was part of the Q2 miss (48.1% vs 51.5%, adjusted EBITDA -12%), and the stock fell 18.46%. Q3 2025 at 51.3% margin was overshadowed by the Q4 warning.
findings.why_not_priced: Partly priced. B. Riley models a 21.1% EBITDA margin against 22.5% in Q2, and a Morgan Stanley H2 EBITDA cut on fuel is listed in late September on stockanalysis. If fully priced, EPS consensus would sit below Q2's $0.36; it is $0.35-0.36. The transmission from diesel to COGS is a proxy: outbound freight is a mid-single-digit share of sales, so this is likely tens of basis points. Sized small.
findings.independence: Aug 3 baseline: https://www.agrinews-pubs.com/community-contributed/2026/08/04/fuel-gauge-for-week-ending-aug-3/. Fuel costs flagged in B. Riley's preview: https://ca.investing.com/news/stock-market-news/briley-reiterates-buy-on-celsius-stock-ahead-of-q3-results-93CH-4921046. The guide's diesel condition is in the Q2 transcript, page 7 (same document as finding 1).

findings.finding: New forward information is promised for this call. On Aug 6 management said it would give more detail on 2027 innovation load-in timing 'after third-quarter results', and that a new 16-ounce CELSIUS offering launches 'in a meaningful way in '27'. The CFO at Barclays called the payoff 'a '27 and '28 play'. A first concrete 2027 calendar lands in this window.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Forward commentary has moved this stock the most: -24.8% (Q4 noise, Nov 2025), +6.94% (Feb 2026, the 2026 setup), -18.46% (Aug 2026, Q3 'like Q2').
findings.why_not_priced: The content is unknown until the call, so only its existence is priced, mainly through the implied move. Positive lean because retailers were said to be 'leaning in on 2027 planning earlier than they ever had' and the company controls what it discloses.
findings.independence: Q2 transcript page 8 (16-ounce offering in '27): https://s203.q4cdn.com/427437840/files/doc_financials/2026/q2/Celsius-Holdings-Second-Quarter-2026-Earnings-Conference-Call-Transcript.pdf. Barclays 'a 27 and 28 play': https://www.tikr.com/blog/celsius-stock-slid-nearly-7-after-barclays-and-the-real-payoff-it-described-waits-until-2027

findings.finding: Insiders bought at about $27. The CEO bought 18,000 shares on 2026-09-10 at a $27.44 weighted average (about $494k), after 8,475 shares at $29.36 in May. Directors DeSantis and Kravitz each bought about $1.0M. Four insiders bought about $2.7M in total over twelve months, with one small sale.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The stock rose about 2% after the CEO purchase was reported in September. There is no print-day history on this line.
findings.why_not_priced: Public Form 4s, so largely priced. Kept small as evidence that management did not see a Q3 problem worse than the pre-guide when it bought inside the quarter.

findings.finding: The stock ran up into the print with no identified catalyst: +11.76% over 5 sessions and +16.16% over 20 to $31.27, up 4.4% on 2026-11-04 alone. Coverage attributes the move to pre-earnings buying and technicals. Upside is paid in the options (skew -2.15, put/call OI 0.42), which raises the bar for a pre-guided quarter. Against that, 30.1M shares are short (5.5 days to cover).
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q3 2025 came after a 73% YTD run and fell 24.8% on a beat. Q2 2026 came off lows and still fell 18.46%. The last two prints with heavy expectations were sold.
findings.why_not_priced: This is the price itself; the question is how the run-up reacts to a quarter that only meets the pre-guide. If the run-up already reflected fear, puts would be bid; instead calls are bid.
findings.independence: Short interest: https://massive.com/quote/celh. Tape and skew: the sealed baseline.

findings.finding: The buyback is still running. The company repurchased $100.4M in Q2 ($124.5M in H1) and said it 'intend[s] to continue utilizing the $300 million authorization this year', which leaves up to about $175M for H2. Q3 traded at $24-29, so a large Q3 repurchase is likely to be reported.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q2's $100M buyback did not stop an 18.46% fall.
findings.why_not_priced: The intent is public. The Q3 amount and any new authorization are not; a new authorization would be read as a signal at about 2.5x sales.
findings.independence: Q2 transcript page 7 (same management statement), so not independent.

findings.finding: New litigation in October 2026. Two proposed consumer class actions (W.D. Wash. and Illinois, filed around Oct 26-29) challenge the 'Burns Body Fat' and 'Accelerates Metabolism' front labels, and investor class action notices were issued on Nov 3. A prior labeling case settled for $7.8M.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No measurable prior print reaction to litigation.
findings.why_not_priced: Immaterial in dollars. It matters only if management addresses labeling changes on the call.
findings.independence: https://stockanalysis.com/stocks/celh/ (Oct 29 lawsuit headline); https://massive.com/quote/celh (Nov 3 class action notices)

findings.finding: The Q4 comparison is hard. Management flagged on Aug 6 that Q4 comparisons are affected by the prior-year inventory build tied to Alani Nu's Pepsi distribution transition, so the Q4 outlook on the call will likely show weak year-over-year optics. B. Riley instead argues Q4 compares favorably because Q4 2025 revenue fell 7.7% after Q3 2025's +44%.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q4 commentary on the Q3 2025 call ('noise' from the Alani load-in) coincided with a 24.8% fall.
findings.why_not_priced: Disclosed in August, so mostly priced. Sized small because a sell-side preview reads the comparison the other way.

findings.finding: The distributor is under pressure in the period. PepsiCo said on 2026-10-08 that North America 'performed below our expectations', that PBNA organic revenue declined slightly on lower volume, and that structural cost reductions are coming. Celsius sells mostly through Pepsi's DSD system, so a cost-cutting distributor could keep CELSIUS inventory lean (the 'rebalancing' already seen) into Q4.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Pepsi inventory reductions drove the Q3 2024 collapse ($100-120M destock) and the 2026 'rebalancing' gap: about half of Q2's 10-point gap between scans and net sales.
findings.why_not_priced: This is a proxy: Pepsi did not say it would cut Celsius inventory, and the same document says energy gained share. Sized small for that reason.
findings.independence: Same PepsiCo document as the Alani finding, read for a different line. Q2 rebalancing commentary is in the Q2 transcript page 6.

outside_window.finding: England plans to restrict sales of drinks above 150mg/L caffeine to under-16s, targeted for April 2027 and still needing parliamentary approval. Celsius is caught by the threshold; international was about 4.5% of Q1 sales.

A second North Carolina manufacturing line starts in H2 2026 with full benefit in 2027, and permanent CELSIUS innovation returns to shelves in 1H27. The margin and brand recovery are dated after the window; only the call's description of them is inside it (filed as a finding).

baseline_tension: The evidence leans slightly against the upside skew and the 11.8% five-day run-up: CELSIUS scans worsened and diesel rose after the margin guide. Most of that was public in September and the bar has been cut to the pre-guide, so the lean is small and moderated by 5.5 days to cover.
lessons_applied: Rule 6 (a finding inside the guide is a reported-quarter item): the pre-guided Q3 finding cut from +0.5 to +0.3.
Rule 6 (disputed bar, $800.6M vs $815.9M across two source pairs): the revenue-dependent Alani finding capped, +1.0 to +0.7.
Rule 7 (crowded short shrinks negatives; 30.1M short, 5.5 days to cover): CELSIUS scan finding -1.5 to -1.2, diesel finding -1.0 to -0.8, and p_up 45 to 46.
Rule 3 (own caveat must reach the number): the Q4-comparison finding, contradicted in direction by B. Riley's preview, cut from -0.3 to -0.2.
Rules 1 and 8 (understatement; the forward read decides this name, median reaction 17.3%): abs_move_pct raised from 12 to 13.
Rule 5 (proxies filed small, not dropped): the Pepsi North America and diesel proxies kept, sized small. print_vs_bar_pct unchanged at 0.0.
